status: partially scored (protein/mutation expectations); drug/agent expectations pending
preregistered_at: 2026-11-07 (commit this file BEFORE running the pipeline; the commit timestamp is the record)
purpose: Portability test: run the unchanged graph / GNN-A / agent pipeline on CPTAC-BRCA without disease-specific retraining, and check pre-stated biological expectations.

selection_method.principle: Patients were chosen using DNA copy number, RNA and somatic mutations only. Expectations concern what the PROTEIN-based pipeline (patient protein edges, GNN-A ranking, retrieval, agent) should find, so selection and evaluation use different data and the test is not circular.

sources.rna: cptac Brca transcriptomics (broad), ESR1 (first transcript; PGR unusable because broad is transcript-level)

selection_method.not_used: No stage, grade, recurrence or survival. PAM50 calls (Krug et al., Cell 2020) were not available in cptac; if obtained later, report agreement as a secondary check.

normalization_note: CPTAC-BRCA has no normal samples, so protein z-scores are relative to the BRCA tumor cohort ('up' = high compared with other breast tumors), unlike ccRCC (relative to normal kidney).

expectations.statement: ERBB2 is among the patient's top-50 up-regulated proteins.
At least one co-amplified 17q12 neighbour (GRB7, STARD3 or PGAP3) is also among the top-50 up-regulated proteins.
A HER2-targeting drug (trastuzumab, pertuzumab, lapatinib, neratinib or tucatinib) appears in rank_for_patient(drug, k=10) or in the agent's cited drug-target evidence.
ESR1 is NOT among the top-50 up-regulated proteins.
ERBB2 is among the top-50 up-regulated proteins.
A HER2-targeting drug appears in rank_for_patient(drug, k=10) or the agent's cited drug-target evidence.
ESR1 or an ER-program protein (GATA3, FOXA1, PGR) is among the top-50 up-regulated proteins.
An endocrine drug acting on the estrogen receptor (tamoxifen, fulvestrant, raloxifene, toremifene) appears in rank_for_patient(drug, k=10) or the agent's cited evidence.
No HER2-targeting drug is presented as a top target for this patient.
If the CDH1 mutation is truncating (nonsense/frameshift/splice), CDH1 (E-cadherin) protein is among the top-50 DOWN-regulated proteins.
PIK3CA appears as a mutation edge, and the agent connects it to PI3K-pathway biology with cited evidence (e.g. alpelisib-PIK3CA drug-target edge).
ESR1 or an ER-program protein is among the top-50 up-regulated proteins.
ESR1 is NOT up-regulated; if measured, it is among the top-50 down-regulated proteins.
At least one basal or proliferation marker (KRT5, KRT14, KRT17, EGFR, MKI67, TOP2A) is among the top-50 up-regulated proteins.
Neither a HER2-targeting drug nor an endocrine drug is presented as a top target.

scoring: Each expectation is scored met / not met / not testable (e.g. protein not measured), with the evidence. All results are reported, including misses; none are dropped.
